summary: Iteration 111 backend + frontend smoke of PIUP (OVC) + marketplace cart/orders + OVC branding + BRUNO CARDS regression. 16/16 pytest cases pass. Frontend testids verified on login/register/legal/terms/privacy (OVC attribution), /marketplace tabs & /marketplace/piup, cart (correctly blocked with 409 seller_not_ready, cart-checkout-btn disabled, 2 seller-not-ready chips), non-admin 'Solo administradores' guard on /admin/piup, admin login + admin-piup-page with orders/catalog/stats tabs, /purchases tabs including purchases-tab-piup with 4 piup-order-* cards (prior paid PIUP orders present → money flow working), /payment/cancel renders 'Pago cancelado', card builder edit shows save-status data-status=saved (autosave regression ok). The Stripe-hosted payment page itself was NOT completed by automation (3DS/hosted-page), so the end-to-end PIUP paid flow was validated via existing paid orders already present in the account.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/piup.py: _enrich_product does not merge admin-edited fields like description/images/stock when they exist on the DB row — it uses the raw DB row via **p, so this is fine, but note that DEFAULT_COLORS are always overridden regardless of per-product color overrides (acceptable per current spec).

routers/marketplace_orders.py line 221: operator precedence bug risk — `not o or current_user.id not in (o['buyer_id'], o['seller_id']) and not money.is_admin(current_user)` — Python precedence makes it `not o OR (uid not in tuple AND not admin)`. This is actually the intended semantics (if the user is admin, allow). Just worth adding parentheses for readability.

routers/piup.py line 242 and 408: fallback to PIUP_CATALOG when DB missing is good, but 408 then calls `product['stock']` which is only defined on DB rows — a static-catalog fallback would raise KeyError on the `product.get('stock')` call… actually it uses .get so it's safe. OK.

CartPage.jsx uses per-seller testids: delivery-ship-{sellerId} and delivery-chat-{sellerId}; spec in review_request referred to plain `delivery-ship`/`delivery-chat` — tester-side observation, not a bug. All functionality correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (Stripe hosted page not automatable)
